crossRefs.note: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.
Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;
He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in Yahweh.
He will deliver you in six troubles; yes, in seven no evil will touch you.
The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.
When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk…
He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there…
So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”
I laid myself down and slept. I awakened; for Yahweh sustains me.
For the Lord had made the army of the Syrians to hear the sound of chariots, and the sound of horses, even the noise of…
In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falls on men,
The murderer rises with the light. He kills the poor and needy. In the night he is like a thief.
Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.
My heart flutters. Horror has frightened me. The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me.
“But God said to him, ‘You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared—whose…
But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would have watched, and…
For the arrows of the Almighty are within me. My spirit drinks up their poison. The terrors of God set themselves in…
He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys.

translations.web: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day,
translations.bsb: You will not fear the terror of the night, nor the arrow that flies by day,
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;
translations.asv: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, Nor for the arrow that flieth by day;
